scripts.clean: powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue dist, build, android/app/build, dist-apks"
scripts.build:all: powershell -Command "npm run clean; npm run build; npx cap sync android; Set-Location android; .\gradlew assembleDebug; Set-Location ..; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path dist-apks; Copy-Item 'android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk' 'dist-apks\supertaxi-driver-v6.0.1.apk' -Force; Copy-Item 'android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk' 'dist-apks\supertaxi-passenger-v6.0.1.apk' -Force; Copy-Item 'android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk' 'dist-apks\supertaxi-staff-v6.0.1.apk' -Force; Copy-Item 'android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk' 'dist-apks\supertaxi-v6.0.1.apk' -Force; Get-ChildItem -Path dist-apks"
scripts.build:apks: powershell -Command "npm run build; npx cap sync android; Set-Location android; .\gradlew assembleDebug; Set-Location ..; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path dist-apks; Copy-Item 'android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk' 'dist-apks\supertaxi-driver-v6.0.1.apk' -Force; Copy-Item 'android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk' 'dist-apks\supertaxi-passenger-v6.0.1.apk' -Force; Copy-Item 'android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk' 'dist-apks\supertaxi-staff-v6.0.1.apk' -Force; Copy-Item 'android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk' 'dist-apks\supertaxi-v6.0.1.apk' -Force; Get-ChildItem -Path dist-apks"
